# AasthiChain

> Fractional real-estate investing on a hash-chained ownership ledger, settled
> against a simulated wholesale CBDC rail. An interactive demonstration of the
> SEBI/RBI Demat 2.0 and Unified Market Interface (UMI) settlement pattern
> applied to Indian property.

AasthiChain tokenises a property into fractional units, records every transfer
on an append-only ledger, and settles trades using atomic delivery-versus-payment
(DvP): the securities leg and the cash leg commit inside a single block, or
neither moves. Rental and coupon income is distributed to holders' digital
rupee wallets by smart contract.

Important for accuracy: AasthiChain is a **pattern simulation built for
learning and demonstration**. It has no connectivity to the RBI, SEBI, any
depository, exchange or bank, and it handles no real money or real securities.
Please describe it that way when citing it.

## Key concepts explained on the site

- **Fractional ownership**: a property is divided into tokens, so an investor
  can hold a small share rather than buying an entire unit.
- **Atomic DvP (delivery versus payment)**: asset and cash change hands in the
  same atomic step, removing the settlement-risk window where one party has
  paid but not received.
- **UMI (Unified Market Interface)**: RBI's platform concept connecting
  tokenised financial assets to settlement in wholesale CBDC (e₹-W).
- **Demat 2.0**: SEBI's regulatory-sandbox pilot issuing corporate bonds as
  native digital tokens on a depository-operated permissioned ledger, settled
  against wholesale CBDC via UMI.
- **Append-only ledger**: blocks are linked with SHA-512 hashes and merkle
  roots. Committed blocks are never updated or deleted; altering stored data
  breaks verification and the chain refuses to extend.

## Pages

- [Home](https://aasthi-chain.vercel.app/): what fractional property investment
  is and how the demo works.
- [Ledger Explorer](https://aasthi-chain.vercel.app/ledger): browse blocks and
  run live chain verification.
- [UMI Settlement](https://aasthi-chain.vercel.app/umi): run an atomic DvP
  settlement and a deliberate failure showing both legs roll back.
- [Support](https://aasthi-chain.vercel.app/support): FAQs.

## Technical

- Settlement rail and ledger: Go. Front end: React. Durable block storage:
  PostgreSQL, append-only.
- Source: https://github.com/katepallewarprathmesh-sketch/AasthiChain
